blocks.text: JavaScript PlainYearMonth
The Temporal.PlainYearMonth Object
The Temporal.PlainYearMonth object is a year and month object.
It represents the year and month of an ISO 8601 calendar without day or time.
Example: 2026-05.
How to Create a PlainYearMonth Object
An PlainYearMonth object can be created in different ways:
Create a PlainYearMonth with new

The new PlainYearMonth() constructor creates a new PlainYearMonth object
with integers as input parameters.

// Create a PlainYearMonth object

const date = new Temporal.PlainYearMonth(2026, 5);
blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: PlainYearMonth from(object)

The from() method creates a new PlainYearMonth object with an
object as input parameter.

// Create a PlainYearMonth object

const date = new Temporal.PlainYearMonth({year:2026, month:5});
blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: PlainYearMonth from(RFC 9557)

The from() method creates a new PlainYearMonth object with an
ISO / RFC 9557 string as input parameter.

// Create a PlainYearMonth object

const date = Temporal.PlainYearMonth.from("2025-05");
blocks.caption: Examples

blocks.text:
// Create a PlainYearMonth object

const date = Temporal.PlainYearMonth.from("2025-05-17");
blocks.caption: Examples

blocks.text: Note that the day input is ignored in the last example.
